mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Katarina is channeling her ultimate. Enemy champions stay in range at their peril!

mLocKeys.keySummary: Champion kills or assists grant Katarina extra gold and reduce her cooldowns by 15 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Champion takedowns grant Katarina <gold>@bonusGold@ gold</gold> and her cooldowns are reduced by 15 seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Katarina instantly moves to her target's location and takes reduced damage from enemies for a few seconds. If the target is an enemy, she deals damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Moves to a target's location. Deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> if the target is an enemy.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Katarina throws a dagger that bounces from enemy to enemy, dealing magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Throws a dagger dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. The dagger bounces an additional @MaxBounces@ times dealing 10% less damage with each bounce.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, throwing daggers with unrivaled speed at up to three nearby Champions.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Becomes a flurry of blades, throwing daggers at the closest 3 enemy Champions dealing <magicDamage>@DamageCalcTooltipOnly@ magic damage</magicDamage> over 2 seconds.
Katarina's next {{Spell_KatarinaQ_Jade_Name}} or {{Spell_KatarinaE_Jade_Name}} will have an additional effect.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Katarina's next basic spell gains an additional affect.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Katarina's Abilities and Attacks deal an additional @TotalDamage@ damage.

Active: Katarina's next basic Ability has a bonus effect.
  • Bouncing Blade: Deals full damage to every target and applies Grievous Wounds for @QHealingReductionDuration@ seconds.
  • Shunpo: Katarina gains @EDamageReduction@% damage reduction for @EDamageReductionDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <keyword>Grievous Wounds</keyword>: Reduces the effectiveness of Healing and Regeneration effects.
